Evaluate viable alternative solution categories for the approved problem and constraints.

- Read the project brief and `docs/research/01-market-landscape.md` when available.
- Save `docs/research/02-alternatives.md` using the research report template.
- Compare extensibility, integration, skills, security, operations, cost model, lock-in, and fit by organization size.
- Distinguish product facts from estimated total cost or recommendations.
- Update the source register and assign `INSIGHT-NNN` IDs.

Do not select the final architecture or technology in this step.
